through_line.name: the black coffee
through_line.prop_prompt: a tall paper coffee cup with a domed plastic lid and a dark ring of coffee staining the rim, no sleeve, slightly crushed at the middle
progression: a dark stream starting down the empty tube
the stream running hard and steady
the dark liquid pools and looks around for food
the pool covers the whole empty floor
the cavity is dark, full, and vibrating

blocks.through_line_state: a dark stream starting down the empty tube
blocks.sfx: a pour, a lid click, a hollow echo
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes calling down into a very empty tube
CLOSE, low angle: Gut looking up, hopeful for once
MEDIUM, high angle: a thin dark stream beginning down the wall
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut's hope closing back down

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: Morning. Something's coming down.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Is there any food with it?

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: There's coffee. Large. Black coffee.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: I asked if there was food, Pipes.

blocks.through_line_state: the stream running hard and steady
blocks.sfx: a steady pour, a hollow drip, a creak
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Gut shouting up an empty tube, echo and all
MEDIUM, eye level: Pipes standing in the stream, shrugging
MEDIUM, high angle: the stream thickening, no end in sight
CLOSE on Pipes' eyes glancing away

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: It's seven in the morning. I'm empty.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: I know. She's already halfway through it.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Nothing has been down here since yesterday.

turns.speaker: pipes
turns.line: She's ordering a second one.

blocks.through_line_state: the dark liquid pools and looks around for food
blocks.sfx: a hot splash, a hollow echo, a sharp hiss
shots: MEDIUM, high angle: dark liquid spreading across a completely bare floor
CLOSE, low angle: two alert eyes rising out of the dark pool
MEDIUM, eye level: the coffee turning, searching the empty room
CLOSE on the eyes: the coffee realizing there is nothing here

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Oh, that's hot. That is hot.

turns.speaker: coffee
turns.line: Rise and grind! Where's the food?

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: There is no food.

turns.speaker: coffee
turns.line: None? Just me? In here? Alone?

blocks.through_line_state: the pool covers the whole empty floor
blocks.sfx: a phone tap, a dull hum, a flat beep
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: HQ mid-scroll, not looking up
CLOSE, low angle: the phone lighting HQ from below
MEDIUM, high angle: HQ shrugging with the phone still raised
CLOSE on HQ's eyes flicking back to the screen

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: HQ, we skipped breakfast again.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: We didn't skip it. We forgot.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Third day in a row, HQ.

turns.speaker: hq
turns.line: Let me look it up. Hold on.

blocks.sfx: a fast drip, a panicked squeak, a rattling buzz
shots: CLOSE, low angle: Buzz vibrating into frame
MEDIUM, eye level: Buzz gesturing wildly, Gut deflating
MEDIUM, high angle: Buzz following Gut across the room
CLOSE on the eyes: Buzz pleading directly at camera

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Buzz, take some pressure off me.

turns.speaker: buzz
turns.line: Off you? I'm at four percent.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: You said four percent yesterday.

turns.speaker: buzz
turns.line: Nobody's listening to me. Nobody ever does.

blocks.through_line_state: the cavity is dark, full, and vibrating
blocks.sfx: a low tremor, a rattling hum, one long silence
shots: MEDIUM, eye level: the tunnel walls faintly trembling
CLOSE, low angle: Gut steadying himself against the wall
MEDIUM, high angle: Rusty's eyes opening, perfectly still while everything shakes
CLOSE on the eyes: Gut realizing what the shaking is

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: The whole room is shaking down here.

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: That is not the room.

turns.speaker: gut
turns.line: Then what is it, Rusty?

turns.speaker: rusty
turns.line: That's you. Go sit down.
